findings.text: tests/test_doccheck_slug_collision.py:59 blocking: the landed change carries no committed test. The only guard is /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/r-20261103T073250723891-a-research-or-evidence-document-cannot-carry-a-plans-slug/test_default_audit_slug_collision.py, which dies with the run's scratch, so nothing in the repository fails if _collision_context is removed and the collision check silently stops firing again.

reckon/doccheck.py:2758 non-blocking: _declared_project re-reads the docs-project meta from a path, a read that reckon/_plan_html.py:1372 already exposes as parse_plan(path)["project"]; the second implementation can drift from the parser it mirrors.

reckon/doccheck.py:2818 non-blocking: _load_mounts() is now called once per audited path inside the loop rather than once per run, so a bare audit of many documents re-reads and re-parses mounts.json N times.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 327ce7a6: 0d7db2ae adds _declared_project and _collision_context and rewrites the collision loop in reckon/doccheck.py; d060a1bd adds only the landing fragment; 64 insertions, 10 deletions across two files.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a test that finds audit-doc refusing the colliding record and passing an own-slug one plus a negative control and a base/head suite pair; the manifest's gate ran exactly that and logs/evidence-base.log, evidence-head.log, evidence-neg.log, suite-base.log and suite-head.log record each arm with a revision header and an EXIT= line.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is that a research or evidence document cannot carry a plan's slug; reckon/doccheck.py:2818-2825 now resolves a project per document so a bare audit reaches slug_collision_findings, which is the goal's mechanism.
item_verdicts.manifest: the manifest states status complete, commits 0d7db2ae0e71 and d060a1bdc2, the four evidence/suite logs, and itself records under outside_scope and rubric.tests-in-repo that the evidence test is not committed.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared write paths are reckon/doccheck.py and the node's landing fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/the-crew-does-its-own-bookkeeping/; every path in the diff is one of those two, but the plan section §12 also declares 'the new test' and the dispatch's fence omitted it.

justifications.durability: no test file in the diff; the only guard is /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/r-20261103T073250723891-a-research-or-evidence-document-cannot-carry-a-plans-slug/test_default_audit_slug_collision.py, which the run's scratch removal deletes.
justifications.evidence: the gate command in the manifest drove the bare-audit test at both revisions, and logs/evidence-base.log (1 failed, 1 passed, EXIT=1) and logs/evidence-head.log (2 passed, EXIT=0) record the result rather than claiming it.
justifications.fit: reckon/doccheck.py:2772 follows the module's private-helper idiom and docstring style and adds no plan, section or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/doccheck.py:2818 resolves a project per document so run reaches slug_collision_findings for a bare audit, and the head arm at logs/evidence-head.log shows the colliding record refused.
justifications.reuse: reckon/doccheck.py:2758 re-reads a docs-project meta that reckon/_plan_html.py:1372 already exposes as parse_plan(path)["project"], a small duplicated read rather than a new capability.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff at d060a1bd touches only reckon/doccheck.py and the node's own landing fragment, both inside the declared write paths.
